content:
A positive, laughter-filled evening of relaxation and entertainment with humorist and radio personality Kaspars Upacieris – Ufo. Celebrating its 60th anniversary, Ufo has prepared a special anniversary show for the audience – a fascinating, ironic and at times very personal journey from the eighties to the present day.

Ufo's humor has never been just classic - it boldly balances between irony, self-irony and notes of black humor, allowing you to laugh not only at what is happening around you, but also at yourself. It will be a show with character, energy and a human aftertaste.

It will be a story about peers, the dullness of youth, the brilliance and misery of life, about the times we grew up in and the people we met.

During the show, viewers will experience humorous stories in the format of various "radio shows" - from black humor charts and absurd life situations to memories of the eighties, nineties, 2000s, everyday work, raising chickens, carpentry, homemaking, money matters and other unexpected topics. The evening will be complemented by staged sketches, improvisation, poetry readings, quizzes and, of course, musical elements.

An evening that not only entertains, but also recharges – a real laugh-out-loud event during the darkest time of the year. 

Event duration: ~2 hours (in 2 parts with an intermission)

Recommended age: 16+ (it won't be that crazy, kids can come too)

For questions: +371 20062277

Photography and/or filming will take place during the event. The resulting photo and video materials may be used for publicity of the event.
